description: Search INDICIA DESK's public registry of BTC/ETH market beliefs tested on its own data, including the rejected ones. Use when someone asks whether a popular crypto trading belief holds, e.g. "does max pain attract price?", "do whales lead the move?", "is selling volatility after a fear spike profitable?". Returns verdict status and a plain-language teaser; exact thresholds are not public.
name: hypothesis_ledger

as_of.description: UTC time the underlying data was computed.

stale.description: True when the data is older than its normal refresh cycle.

title: Tested market hypotheses (confirmed and rejected)
